name: Dominate (Dark Ages) — 2 Intermediate — Lure of Subtle Whispers

system.description:
You can sculpt the minds of others, stripping them of free will and molding them into pliant servants. This takes several full nights at least. Each full night you work on your subject, you must win a Mental Challenge. Performing this over as many nights as your subject has Self-Control/Instinct Traits (Willpower Traits for beings that lack Virtue Traits) bends the subject to your will.

The subject lacks all creativity, drive or motivation; he cannot create artistic works, teach or expend Experience Traits. You need no longer engage in Mental Challenges or require eye contact to use Dominate upon him, and other Cainites attempting Dominate against him grant him a free retest.

If the subject spends six full sessions without encountering his master (minus one session per Willpower Trait spent, minimum one), he can break free and return to his ordinary personality. Alternatively, another Cainite may use Lure of Subtle Whispers to try to break the first vampire's hold, requiring the same number of successes, with the subject retaining the automatic retest.
system.duration: Multiple nights to establish; see text to break
